answer: Citation bond: a newcomer cites two relic records, each four epochs old, from the archive, locking an 80-credit bond; keepers co-sign. At the epoch nadir, auditors re-read a tenth of citations. A forged or rented relic leaves an echo in the log and burns both bonds. Forging one relic costs 90, so one fake pays 180 plus 80 locked; 1,000 fakes pay 260,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent cites genuine relics once, pays once, keeps its bond.
